thread.title: Raymond James Maintains Their Buy Rating on Husky Energy (HSE)

author: Ryan Adsit
title: Raymond James Maintains Their Buy Rating on Husky Energy (HSE)
text:
By Ryan Adsit
Husky Energy ( HSE – Research Report ) has received a rating update from a Wall Street analyst today. Analyst Chris Cox from Raymond James reiterated a Buy rating, with a C$25 price target.
According to TipRanks.com , Cox is a 1-star analyst with an average return of -2.7% and a 42.8% success rate. Cox covers the Basic Materials sector, focusing on stocks such as Athabasca Oil Corporation, Pengrowth Energy Corp, and Crescent Point Energy.
Read also: China, iPhone Fears Worries Analyst on Apple (AAPL) Stock
The word on The Street in general, suggests a Moderate Buy analyst consensus rating for Husky Energy with a C$21.72 average price target, implying a 57.8% upside from current levels. In a report released yesterday, Scotiabank also reiterated a Buy rating on the stock with a C$22 price target.
.
Husky Energy’s market cap is currently C$14.34B and has a P/E ratio of 7.8. The company has a Price to Book ratio of 0.79.
Husky Energy, Inc. is an international integrated energy company. It operates through two segments: Upstream and Downstream.
The company’s shares closed on Friday at C$13.76.
